primaryChecks.text: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.
primaryChecks.nextContext: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”
